name: NORIZO DEV ROOM provider-neutral worker state contract
purpose: Reusable checkpoint and heartbeat convention for RELIS, OMNW, CNW, SAYAKA and other project workers without binding state to a hosting provider.

semantics.sequence: Monotonic integer advanced only after a durable successful checkpoint.
semantics.cursor: Provider-neutral resume token or logical cursor; null before first durable progress.
semantics.watermark: Source-domain watermark such as updated_at, source ID, page token, or batch boundary.
semantics.last_success_at: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last completed durable unit.
semantics.input_fingerprint: Optional deterministic fingerprint of input scope used to detect drift.
semantics.output_fingerprint: Optional deterministic fingerprint of durable output used for handoff verification.

semantics.observed_at: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest observation.
semantics.last_success_at: ISO-8601 timestamp or null when no successful run has occurred.
semantics.consecutive_failures: Non-negative integer reset to zero after success.
semantics.run_id: Provider-neutral run identifier; may be null when idle.
semantics.detail: Short operational note with no secrets.

rules: max_side_effects_per_run is a non-negative integer or null when the worker is read-only
state files must contain no secrets
